evidence_quotes.O: When it comes to home networking equipment I've used or tried just about all. From Netgear, D-Link, TP-Link, Linksys, 2Wire, Buffalo, Almond and so many more.
evidence_quotes.C: I've spent the last 2 months researching my next television purchase. I'm one of those people that over-researches the pros and cons of any major purchase.
evidence_quotes.E: This is my first racing wheel and as a fan of all things Gran Turismo there is no other way to race!
evidence_quotes.A: Unfortunately I read the wrong dimensions - the entire bag dimensions instead of the inner compartment dimensions which are listed separately.
evidence_quotes.N: I'm going to try and capture my experience with the Cheetah APTMM2B mount as accurately as possible without this turning into a rant.
